summary: Steep Morrow Street kerb with apartments 8 m away and no-parking signs.

best_section.where: Morrow Street north kerb, west of the Moorak junction

drivers.seclusion: Apartment blocks directly behind the kerb, 8 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside lane where some cars park, but signed no-parking and loading zones along it.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with a junction at the east end.
drivers.convention: No-parking specified times and loading zone signs; cars do park along parts.

sun_shade: Open to the sky; apartment blocks shade the kerb from the north in the morning.
